meta.disclaimer: Izi ndi chidziwitso chokha — si kudziwitsa matenda kapena kupereka mankhwala. Nthawi zonse funsani wogwira ntchito yazaumoyo ngati simukudziwa.
meta.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Matenda a kachilombo a mphuno ndi pakhosi
entries.content_ny: Chimfine ndi matenda ofatsa a kachilombo m'mphuno ndi pakhosi. Anthu ambiri amachira okha pakadutsa masabata 1 kapena 2.
tips_ny: Mupumule ndi kumwa madzi ambiri
Imwani paracetamol kapena ibuprofen monga mwauzidwa palemba la mankhwala kuti muchepetse kupweteka ndi kutentha thupi
Sambani m'manja pafupipafupi ndipo gwiritsani nsalu poyetsemula kuti musapatsire ena
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Zizindikiro zikamatha masabata oposa atatu, mukavutika kupuma kapena kumva kupweteka pachifuwa, kapena khanda kapena munthu wodwala matenda a nthawi yaitali akadwala kwambiri, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Matenda a kachilombo oyamba mwadzidzidzi ndi kutentha thupi ndi kupweteka kwa minofu
entries.content_ny: Fuluwenza ndi matenda a kachilombo omwe amayamba mwadzidzidzi ndi kutentha thupi, kupweteka kwa minofu ndi kutopa. Anthu ambiri athanzi amachira pakadutsa pafupifupi sabata imodzi.
tips_ny: Mupumule, mudziphimbe bwino ndi kumwa madzi ambiri
Imwani paracetamol monga mwauzidwa kuti muchepetse kutentha thupi ndi kupweteka
Khalani panyumba pamene mukudwala kuti musapatsire ena
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukamva kupweteka pachifuwa kapena kuvutika kupuma, zizindikiro zikapanda kuchepa pakatha sabata, kapena ngati muli ndi pakati, ndinu wachikulire, mwana wamng'ono, kapena muli ndi matenda a nthawi yaitali, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Kukhosomola kwa nthawi yochepa kapena yaitali
entries.content_ny: Zifuwa zambiri zimayamba chifukwa cha matenda monga chimfine ndipo nthawi zambiri zimatha zokha pakadutsa masabata atatu.
tips_ny: Imwani zakumwa zotentha; uchi ndi mandimu zimatha kuchepetsa chifuwa (musapatse uchi mwana wosakwana chaka chimodzi)
Mupumule ndi kumwa madzi ambiri
Pewani utsi ndi zinthu zina zokwiyitsa
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Chifuwa chikatha masabata awiri kapena atatu kapena kuposerapo, mukakhosomola magazi, kuonda, kutuluka thukuta usiku, kupweteka pachifuwa kapena kupuma movutikira, pitani kuchipatala. Chifuwa cha masabata awiri kapena kuposerapo chiyenera kuyezedwa TB.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kupweteka pakhosi kochuluka kumayamba chifukwa cha kachilombo ndipo kumatha pakadutsa pafupifupi sabata popanda maantibayotiki.
tips_ny: Gargulani ndi madzi ofunda a mchere (akuluakulu ndi ana akuluakulu)
Imwani zakumwa zozizira kapena zofunda zambiri
Imwani paracetamol monga mwauzidwa kuti muchepetse ululu
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukavutika kumeza kapena kupuma, mukatulutsa malovu osalekeza, mukakhala ndi kutentha thupi kwambiri, kapena pakhosi pakapitirira kupweteka kupitirira sabata, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kutentha thupi ndi pamene thupi limatentha pafupifupi 38 digiri C kapena kuposerapo. Ndi chizindikiro choti thupi likulimbana ndi matenda. M'madera omwe muli malungo, aliyense wotentha thupi ayenera kuyezedwa malungo.
tips_ny: Mupumule ndi kumwa madzi ambiri
Valani zovala zopepuka ndipo chipinda chizizirire
Imwani paracetamol monga mwauzidwa palemba la mankhwala
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mwana wosakwana miyezi itatu akatentha thupi, kapena kutentha thupi kukakhala ndi khosi lolimba, kusokonezeka maganizo, khunyu, totupa tosazimiririka mukatikanikiza ndi galasi, kapena kutenga masiku opitirira atatu, pitani kuchipatala. M'dera la malungo, yezetsani malungo tsiku lomwelo.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kupweteka mutu kochuluka kumayamba chifukwa cha kupsinjika maganizo ndipo kumatha kuchepetsedwa ndi kupumula, kumwa madzi ndi mankhwala ochepetsa ululu ogulitsa m'masitolo.
tips_ny: Imwani madzi ndi kupumula pamalo abata, amdima
Ikani nsalu yozizira pamphumi
Imwani paracetamol kapena ibuprofen monga mwauzidwa
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukakhala ndi mutu wopweteka kwambiri woyamba mwadzidzidzi, kapena mutu ndi kusintha kwa kuona, kusokonezeka maganizo kapena khosi lolimba, pitani kuchipatala nthawi yomweyo.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kutsegula m'mimba ndi kupita kuchimbudzi chamadzi katatu kapena kuposerapo pa tsiku. Choopsa chachikulu ndi kuchepa kwa madzi m'thupi, komwe kungapewedwe ndi madzi a shuga ndi mchere (ORS).
tips_ny: Imwani madzi ambiri ndi ORS kuti mubwezere madzi ndi mchere omwe mwataya
Pitirizani kudya zakudya zochepa pafupipafupi
Sambani m'manja ndi sopo mukatuluka kuchimbudzi ndi musanaphike chakudya
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukapeza magazi mu chimbudzi, kutsegula m'mimba kukapitirira masiku opitirira 7, kutentha thupi kwambiri, kapena zizindikiro za kuchepa madzi m'thupi monga ludzu lalikulu, mkodzo wakuda, chizungulire kapena mkodzo wochepa, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kusanza nthawi zambiri kumayamba chifukwa cha matenda a m'mimba kapena chakudya chosakhala bwino ndipo nthawi zambiri kumatha pakadutsa tsiku limodzi kapena awiri.
tips_ny: Imwani madzi kapena ORS pang'ono pang'ono pafupipafupi
Mupumule ndipo musadye zakudya zolimba mpaka kusanza kuchepe
Mukamva bwino, yambaninso kudya zakudya zosavuta zochepa
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukasanza kupitirira masiku awiri, kusanza magazi, kupweteka kwambiri m'mimba, mutu waukulu ndi khosi lolimba, kapena zizindikiro zakuchepa madzi m'thupi, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Kulephera kupita kuchimbudzi kapena chimbudzi cholimba
entries.content_ny: Kudzimbidwa ndi kupita kuchimbudzi kocheperapo kuposa nthawi zonse, kapena chimbudzi cholimba ndi chopweteka. Nthawi zambiri kumatha kusintha ndi kusintha zakudya ndi moyo.
tips_ny: Idyani zakudya zambiri za ulusi monga zipatso, ndiwo zamasamba, nyemba ndi mbewu zosakonzedwa
Imwani madzi ambiri
Chitani masewera olimbitsa thupi ndipo pitani kuchimbudzi mukamva kufuna
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukapeza magazi mu chimbudzi, kupweteka kwambiri m'mimba, kuonda popanda chifukwa, kapena kudzimbidwa kukapanda kusintha pakadutsa pafupifupi sabata la kusintha zakudya, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Kumva kutentha pachifuwa kapena m'mimba chapamwamba
entries.content_ny: Kutentha pamtima ndi kusagaya chakudya kumachitika pamene asidi wa m'mimba amakwiyitsa chitoliro cha chakudya kapena m'mimba. Kusintha moyo nthawi zambiri kumathandiza.
tips_ny: Idyani chakudya chochepa pa nthawi ndipo musadye usiku kwambiri
Muchepetse zakudya zamafuta kapena zokometsera, mowa ndi khofi
Musasute fodya, ndipo kwezani mutu mukamagona
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukavutika kumeza, kusanza mobwerezabwereza, chimbudzi chakuda, kuonda popanda chifukwa, kapena kupweteka pachifuwa komwe kungakhale kwa mtima, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kupweteka msana kochuluka kumachira pakadutsa masabata ochepa. Kukhala wokangalika nthawi zambiri kumathandiza kuposa kugona pabedi nthawi yaitali.
tips_ny: Pitirizani kuyenda ndi kuchita zinthu zofewa monga momwe ululu ukuloleza
Gwiritsani nsalu yotentha kapena yozizira pamalo opweteka
Imwani paracetamol monga mwauzidwa palemba la mankhwala
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukamva kusowa kumva pozungulira ntchafu kapena matako, kulephera kuletsa mkodzo kapena chimbudzi, kufooka kwa miyendo, kutentha thupi, kupweteka pambuyo povulala, kapena ululu wosachira pakadutsa masabata angapo, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Ululu mu dzino kapena pafupi ndi dzino
entries.content_ny: Kupweteka dzino nthawi zambiri kumayamba chifukwa cha kuwola kwa dzino kapena matenda a chiseyeye, ndipo kumafunika dokotala wa mano kapena wogwira ntchito yazaumoyo wa mkamwa kuti athetse chomwe chayambitsa.
tips_ny: Tsukulani mkamwa mofatsa ndi madzi ofunda a mchere
Pewani zakudya ndi zakumwa zotentha kwambiri, zozizira kwambiri kapena zotsekemera
Imwani paracetamol monga mwauzidwa, ndipo tsukani mano ndi mankhwala a mano a fluoride
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Nkhope kapena nsagwada zikatupa, mukatentha thupi, kapena mukavutika kumeza kapena kupuma (ndi zadzidzidzi), kapena dzino likapitirira kupweteka kupitirira tsiku limodzi kapena awiri, pitani kuchipatala kapena kwa dokotala wa mano.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Totupa ndi kuyabwa pakhungu zambiri zimakhala zofatsa, zimayamba chifukwa cha kukwiya, ziwengo kapena matenda ang'onoang'ono, ndipo zimatha ndi chisamaliro chosavuta.
tips_ny: Pewani kukanda ndipo sungani khungu lozizira
Siyani kugwiritsa ntchito sopo, mafuta kapena chinthu chatsopano chomwe chingakhale chomwe chayambitsa
Pakani mafuta ofewetsa khungu opanda fungo
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Totupa tikakhala ndi kutentha thupi, tikamafalikira mwachangu, kutuluka matuza, kapena tosazimiririka mukatikanikiza ndi galasi, pitani kuchipatala. Milomo kapena nkhope kutupa kapena kupuma movutikira ndi zadzidzidzi.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kupweteka khutu nthawi zambiri kumayamba chifukwa cha matenda a khutu ndipo nthawi zambiri kumatha pakadutsa masiku ochepa.
tips_ny: Imwani paracetamol monga mwauzidwa kuti muchepetse ululu
Gwiritsani nsalu yofunda pa khutu
Musalowetse kalikonse mkati mwa khutu
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukaona madzi kapena mafinya akutuluka m'khutu, kusamva bwino, kutupa kumbuyo kwa khutu, kutentha thupi kwambiri, kapena zizindikiro zikatha masiku opitirira atatu, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Conjunctivitis ndi matenda kapena ziwengo za m'maso zomwe zimapangitsa maso kukhala ofiira, omata kapena otulutsa madzi. Mitundu yopatsirana nthawi zambiri imatha pakadutsa masabata 1 kapena 2.
tips_ny: Pukutani zikope ndi madzi owiritsa ozizira ndi thonje loyera
Sambani m'manja pafupipafupi ndipo musagawane matawulo
Pewani kukhudza kapena kupukusa maso
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukamva kupweteka kwambiri m'maso, kusintha kwa kuona, kuvutika ndi kuwala, kuvulala m'maso, kapena mwana wakhanda ali ndi maso ofiira kapena omata, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Matenda a tizilombo otengedwa ndi udzudzu
entries.content_ny: Malungo ndi matenda oopsa omwe amafalitsidwa ndi kulumidwa ndi udzudzu wa Anopheles wamkazi wodwala. Zizindikiro zoyamba ndi kutentha thupi, kupweteka mutu ndi kuzizira, choncho kuyezetsa msanga ndi kofunika.
tips_ny: Gonani mu ukonde wa udzudzu woviikidwa mu mankhwala usiku uliwonse
Yezetsani malungo mukangoyamba kutentha thupi
Imwani mankhwala onse monga mwalembedwera
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Pitani kuchipatala tsiku lomwelo ngati mutentha thupi m'dera la malungo. Pitani kuchipatala nthawi yomweyo ngati mutopa kwambiri, musokonezeka maganizo, mukhala ndi khunyu mobwerezabwereza, mukavutika kupuma, mkodzo wakuda kapena wamagazi, maso kapena khungu lachikasu, kapena kutuluka magazi kosazolowereka. Ana osakwana zaka 5 ndi amayi oyembekezera ali pachiopsezo chachikulu.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Matenda a bakiteriya omwe amakhudza kwambiri mapapo
entries.content_ny: TB ndi matenda a bakiteriya omwe amakhudza kwambiri mapapo ndipo amafalikira mumlengalenga munthu wodwala TB akakhosomola. Amachiritsidwa akamwa mankhwala onse mpaka kumaliza.
tips_ny: Phimbani pakamwa mukakhosomola ndipo tsegulani mawindo kuti mpweya ulowe
Yezetsedwe ngati mwakhala ndi chifuwa kwa masabata awiri kapena kuposerapo
Imwani mankhwala a TB nthawi zonse mpaka mutamaliza
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukakhala ndi chifuwa chokhalitsa masabata awiri kapena kuposerapo, kukhosomola magazi, kutentha thupi, kutuluka thukuta usiku kapena kuonda, pitani kuchipatala kukayezedwa. Anthu odwala HIV ndi omwe amakhala nawo pafupi ndi wodwala TB ayeneranso kuyezedwa.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: HIV ndi kachilombo kofooketsa chitetezo cha thupi. Kamafalikira kudzera m'kugonana popanda kondomu, magazi odwala, komanso kuchokera kwa mayi kupita kwa mwana, osati kudzera m'kukhala pamodzi kapena kugwirana. Ndi mankhwala a ARV (ART) anthu amatha kukhala moyo wautali ndi wathanzi.
tips_ny: Yezetsedwe HIV kuchipatala
Gwiritsani ntchito kondomu moyenera nthawi zonse mukamagonana
Mukapezeka ndi HIV, yambani ART ndi kumwa tsiku lililonse; amayi oyembekezera ayezetsedwe kuti ateteze mwana wawo
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukaganiza kuti mwakumana ndi kachilomboka, pitani kuchipatala mwamsanga, makamaka mkati mwa maola 72, kukafunsa za mankhwala oteteza (PEP). Pitaninso kuchipatala ngati mukutentha thupi kosalekeza, kuonda, kapena kudwala mobwerezabwereza.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Matenda otsegula m'mimba kwambiri obwera chifukwa cha madzi kapena chakudya chodetsedwa
entries.content_ny: Kolera ndi matenda obwera chifukwa cha chakudya kapena madzi odetsedwa. Angayambitse kutsegula m'mimba kwambiri kwa madzi ndipo angaphe pakadutsa maola ochepa ngati sachiritsidwa, koma ambiri amatha kuchiritsidwa ndi ORS.
tips_ny: Imwani madzi abwino okha (owiritsa kapena oyeretsedwa)
Sambani m'manja ndi sopo mukatuluka kuchimbudzi ndi musanadye kapena kuphika
Yambani kumwa ORS nthawi yomweyo ndipo pitani kuchipatala
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukatsegula m'mimba kwambiri kwamadzi, kusanza mobwerezabwereza, kukokana kwa miyendo, ludzu lalikulu kapena maso olowa mkati, pitani kuchipatala nthawi yomweyo. Ndi zadzidzidzi, makamaka kwa ana.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Matenda a bakiteriya obwera chifukwa cha chakudya ndi madzi odetsedwa
entries.content_ny: Typhoid ndi matenda a bakiteriya omwe amafalikira kudzera m'chakudya ndi madzi odetsedwa. Amayambitsa kutentha thupi kwa masiku angapo, kupweteka mutu ndi m'mimba, ndipo amachiritsidwa ndi maantibayotiki.
tips_ny: Imwani madzi abwino ndipo idyani chakudya chophikidwa bwino komanso chatsopano
Sambani m'manja ndi sopo musanadye ndi mukatuluka kuchimbudzi
Imwani maantibayotiki monga mwalembedwera ndipo katemera akulangizidwa pomwe alipo
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukatentha thupi masiku angapo ndi kupweteka m'mimba, kudzimbidwa kapena kutsegula m'mimba, pitani kuchipatala. Pitani nthawi yomweyo ngati mwasokonezeka maganizo, mukamva kupweteka kwambiri m'mimba kapena chimbudzi chamagazi.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Matenda a tizilombo obwera chifukwa cha madzi a m'nyanja kapena mitsinje
entries.content_ny: Bilharzia imatengedwa m'madzi a m'nyanja, mitsinje ndi m'madambo okhala ndi nkhono zodwala. Chizindikiro chofala ndi magazi mu mkodzo kapena mu chimbudzi.
tips_ny: Pewani kusambira, kuchapa kapena kuyenda m'madzi omwe angakhale ndi bilharzia
Imwani mankhwala (praziquantel) akaperekedwa ndi chipatala kapena sukulu
Gwiritsani madzi abwino posamba ndi kuchapa
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukapeza magazi mu mkodzo kapena mu chimbudzi, kupweteka m'mimba, kapena zizindikiro zosachoka mutakhudza madzi a m'nyanja kapena mitsinje m'dera lomwe muli bilharzia, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Chibayo ndi matenda a m'mapapo ndipo ndi chimodzi mwa zifukwa zazikulu zomwe ana osakwana zaka 5 amafera. Chimayambitsa chifuwa, kutentha thupi ndi kupuma mofulumira kapena movutikira, ndipo chimachiritsidwa ndi maantibayotiki.
tips_ny: Imwani maantibayotiki onse monga mwalembedwera
Yamwitsani makanda mkaka wa m'mawere wokha kwa miyezi 6 ndipo onetsetsani kuti ana apeza katemera wonse
Sungani ana kutali ndi utsi wa kuphika ndi wa fodya
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mwana kapena wamkulu akapuma mofulumira kapena movutikira, chifuwa chikalowa mkati popuma, milomo ikasanduka yabuluu, kulephera kumwa, kapena kugona kwambiri, pitani kuchipatala nthawi yomweyo. Ndi zadzidzidzi.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Matenda a kachilombo opatsirana mosavuta okhala ndi totupa
entries.content_ny: Chikuku ndi matenda a kachilombo opatsirana mosavuta omwe amayambitsa kutentha thupi, totupa, chifuwa, mphuno yothamanga ndi maso ofiira. Akhoza kukhala oopsa kwa ana aang'ono ndipo amapewedwa ndi katemera.
tips_ny: Patsani ana katemera wa chikuku pa nthawi yake
Sungani mwana wodwala panyumba ndipo mumupatse madzi ambiri
Patsani vitamini A pokhapokha ngati wogwira ntchito yazaumoyo wanena
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mwana akavutika kupuma, kukhala ndi khunyu, madzi otuluka m'khutu, kapena zizindikiro zakuchepa madzi m'thupi, pitani kuchipatala. Pitani kuchipatala mukangoganiza kuti ndi chikuku.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Matenda opuma obwera chifukwa cha kachilombo ka corona
entries.content_ny: COVID-19 ndi matenda opuma omwe amakhala ofatsa mpaka oopsa. Anthu ambiri amachira panyumba, koma ena ali pachiopsezo chodwala kwambiri.
tips_ny: Khalani panyumba ndi kupumula mukadwala, ndipo tsegulani mawindo kuti mpweya ulowe
Sambani m'manja pafupipafupi ndipo valani chophimba kumaso pamalo odzaza anthu mukudwala
Patsani katemera wolangizidwa pa nthawi yake
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukavutika kupuma, kupweteka pachifuwa kosalekeza, kusokonezeka maganizo, milomo yabuluu, kapena ngati muli pachiopsezo chachikulu ndipo mukuipiraipira, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Hepatitis B ndi matenda a kachilombo a chiwindi omwe amafalikira kudzera m'magazi, kugonana komanso kuchokera kwa mayi kupita kwa mwana. Amapewedwa ndi katemera wotetezeka komanso wogwira ntchito.
tips_ny: Pezani katemera, ndipo onetsetsani kuti makanda apeza katemera wa hepatitis B
Musagawane singano, malezala kapena mabulashi a mano
Gwiritsani kondomu ndipo yezetsedwe ngati munakumana ndi kachilomboka
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukakhala ndi khungu kapena maso achikasu, mkodzo wakuda, kutopa kwambiri, kupweteka m'mimba kapena kusanza kosalekeza, pitani kuchipatala. Amayi oyembekezera ayezetsedwe kuti mwana atetezedwe.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kuthamanga kwa magazi nthawi zambiri sikuonetsa zizindikiro, koma kumawonjezera chiopsezo cha matenda a mtima, sitiroko ndi impso. Kuyezetsa pafupipafupi ndi chithandizo zimapewa mavuto.
tips_ny: Muyezetse kuthamanga kwa magazi pafupipafupi
Muchepetse mchere, chitani masewera olimbitsa thupi, musasute fodya ndipo muchepetse mowa
Imwani mankhwala tsiku lililonse ndipo musasiye popanda uphungu
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukakhala ndi mutu waukulu ndi kusokonezeka maganizo, kupweteka pachifuwa, mavuto a maso, kapena kufooka kapena kusamva mbali imodzi ya thupi, pitani kuchipatala nthawi yomweyo. Ndi zadzidzidzi.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Matenda a nthawi yaitali a shuga wambiri m'magazi
entries.content_ny: Matenda a shuga ndi matenda a nthawi yaitali omwe shuga m'magazi amakhala wambiri kwambiri. Zizindikiro zodziwika ndi ludzu lalikulu, kukodza pafupipafupi, kutopa, kuonda ndi mabala ochedwa kupola. Pakapita nthawi angawononge maso, impso, mtima ndi mapazi.
tips_ny: Idyani zakudya zoyenera ndipo pewani zakumwa zotsekemera
Chitani masewera olimbitsa thupi ndipo yang'anani mapazi anu tsiku ndi tsiku
Imwani mankhwala kapena jakisoni wa insulin monga mwalembedwera
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukakhala ndi zizindikiro za matenda a shuga ndipo simunayezedwe, pitani kuchipatala. Pitani nthawi yomweyo ngati mukusanza, kugona kwambiri, kusokonezeka maganizo, kupuma mofulumira kapena mpweya wonunkha ngati zipatso.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Matenda a nthawi yaitali a mpweya
entries.content_ny: Mphumu ndi matenda a nthawi yaitali a m'mapapo omwe amayambitsa kupuma kolira, chifuwa ndi kuvutika kupuma. Amatha kulamulidwa ndi chithandizo choyenera ndi kupewa zoyambitsa.
tips_ny: Gwiritsani inhaler yanu yopulumutsa ndi yoteteza monga mwalembedwera
Pewani zoyambitsa monga utsi, fumbi ndi fungo lamphamvu
Tsatirani ndondomeko ya mphumu yomwe wogwira ntchito yazaumoyo wakupatsani
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukavutika kupuma kwambiri, kulephera kulankhula ziganizo zonse, inhaler yanu yopulumutsa sikugwira ntchito, kapena milomo ikasanduka yabuluu, pitani kuchipatala nthawi yomweyo. Ndi zadzidzidzi.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kuchepa kwa magazi kumatanthauza kuti magazi akunyamula mpweya wochepa. Zifukwa zofala ndi kusowa chitsulo, malungo ndi mphutsi. Kumayambitsa kutopa, khungu lotuwa ndi kupuma movutikira.
tips_ny: Idyani zakudya zokhala ndi chitsulo monga nyemba, masamba obiriwira, nyama ndi nsomba, pamodzi ndi zipatso zokhala ndi vitamini C
Imwani mapiritsi a chitsulo ndi folic acid ngati wogwira ntchito yazaumoyo wakupatsani, mwachitsanzo pa nthawi ya mimba
Pewani ndi kuchiza malungo ndi mphutsi
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukatopa kwambiri, kuoneka wotuwa, kupuma movutikira kapena chizungulire, pitani kuchipatala. Pitani nthawi yomweyo ngati mukumva kupweteka pachifuwa, kukomoka kapena kupuma movutikira kwambiri.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Khunyu ndi matenda omwe amayambitsa kukomoka mobwerezabwereza. Anthu ambiri amatha kulamulira khunyu ndi mankhwala omwe amamwa nthawi zonse. Kudziwa chithandizo cha pakhunyu kumasunga munthuyo otetezeka.
tips_ny: Khalani ndi munthuyo, werengani nthawi ya khunyu ndipo thandizani mutu wake
Chotsani zinthu zolimba ndi kumasula zovala zomuletsa; musaike kalikonse mkamwa mwake kapena kumugwira mwamphamvu
Khunyu likatha, mutembenuzireni mofatsa kumbali
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Ndi khunyu loyamba, likatha mphindi zoposa 5, likabwerabwera popanda kudzuka, munthuyo wavulala, ali ndi pakati kapena akuvutika kupuma pambuyo pake, pitani nawo kuchipatala nthawi yomweyo.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Mabala ambiri ang'onoang'ono amatha kuchiritsidwa panyumba poletsa magazi ndi kusunga bala loyera.
tips_ny: Sambani m'manja, kenako tsukani bala ndi madzi oyera oyenda
Kanikizani mwamphamvu ndi nsalu yoyera kuti magazi aleke
Phimbani ndi bandeji yoyera ndipo sungani bala louma ndi loyera
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Bala likakhala lakuya, magazi akapanda kuleka pakatha mphindi 10 mukukanikiza, dothi litalowa, ndi lolumidwa ndi nyama kapena munthu, kapena likasonyeza zizindikiro za matenda monga kufalikira kufiira, mafinya kapena kutentha thupi, pitani kuchipatala. Funsani za katemera wa tetanasi.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.topic_ny: Kupsa ndi moto kapena madzi otentha
entries.content_ny: Muzizire malo opsa mwamsanga kuti muchepetse kuwonongeka ndi ululu. Mabala ambiri opsa pang'ono amatha kuchiritsidwa panyumba, koma ochuluka kapena ozama amafunika chithandizo chachipatala.
tips_ny: Tsukani malo opsa ndi madzi ozizira (osati a ayezi) oyenda kwa mphindi 20
Chotsani zodzikongoletsera ndi zovala pafupi ndi malo opsa, pokhapokha zitamatirira pakhungu
Phimbani mofewa ndi pulasitiki woyera wophimbira chakudya kapena nsalu yoyera; musapake ayezi, batala kapena mankhwala a mano
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Malo opsa akakhala aakulu kuposa dzanja la munthu, akuya, otuluka matuza, kapena pankhope, m'manja, m'mapazi kapena pa ziwalo zobisika, pitani kuchipatala. Pitaninso nthawi iliyonse ya kupsa ndi mankhwala kapena magetsi, komanso kupsa kulikonse kwa ana aang'ono.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kutuluka magazi m'mphuno kochuluka sikuopsa ndipo kumasiya pakadutsa mphindi 10 mpaka 15 ngati mukukanikiza moyenera.
tips_ny: Khalani chilili ndi kuwerama kutsogolo; musatambasulire mutu kumbuyo
Kanikizani mbali yofewa ya mphuno mwamphamvu kwa mphindi 10 mpaka 15
Pumani pakamwa ndipo mulavule magazi aliwonse
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Magazi akapitirira kutuluka kupitirira mphindi 20, akatuluka ambiri, atatha kuvulala pamutu, kapena mukamva chizungulire kapena kufooka, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kutsamwa kumachitika chinthu chikatseka njira ya mpweya. Munthuyo akatha kukhosomola, mulimbikitseni. Ngati sangathe kulankhula, kukhosomola kapena kupuma, chitanipo nthawi yomweyo. Makanda ndi ana aang'ono amafuna njira ina, choncho phunzirani chithandizo choyamba.
tips_ny: Mulimbikitseni munthuyo kupitiriza kukhosomola
Ngati sangakhosomole, mumenyeni mwamphamvu kumsana pakati pa mapewa mpaka ka 5
Ngati sizikuthandiza, mukanikizeni m'mimba mmwamba mpaka ka 5 (manja ogwirizana pamwamba pa mchombo)
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Chinthucho chikapanda kutuluka, itanani thandizo ladzidzidzi nthawi yomweyo ndipo pitirizani kubwereza. Aliyense amene wakanikizidwa m'mimba ayenera kuyang'aniridwa ndi wogwira ntchito yazaumoyo.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.topic_ny: Kupindika kwa mfundo ndi kuvulala kwa minofu
entries.content_ny: Kupindika kwa mfundo ndi kuvulala kwa minofu nthawi zambiri kumachira ndi kupumula ndi chisamaliro chosavuta pakadutsa masiku mpaka masabata.
tips_ny: Mupumule ndipo musapondereze malo ovulala
Ikani ayezi wokulungidwa munsalu kwa mphindi 20 pa maola 2 mpaka 3 aliwonse
Mangani mofewa ndi nsalu ndipo kwezani mwendo kapena dzanja pokhala
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukalephera kuponda, kupweteka kwambiri, kusamva, kuoneka kosiyana kapena kutupa kwambiri, kapena zosachira pakadutsa masiku angapo, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kukomoka ndi kutaya chidziwitso kwa kanthawi, nthawi zambiri chifukwa cha magazi ochepa kupita mu ubongo. Anthu ambiri amachira mwamsanga.
tips_ny: Gonekani munthuyo chagada ndi kukweza miyendo yake
Masulani zovala zolimba ndipo onetsetsani kuti akupeza mpweya wabwino
Akachira, mukhazikeni pang'onopang'ono ndi kumupatsa madzi
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Akapanda kuchira pakatha mphindi imodzi kapena ziwiri, wavulala, akumva kupweteka pachifuwa kapena mtima ukuthamanga, ali ndi pakati, kapena ndi nthawi yoyamba kukomoka, pitani naye kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kulumidwa ndi njoka kungaphe, koma chithandizo chachangu kuchipatala chimapulumutsa miyoyo. Mankhwala a ululu wa njoka (antivenom) amaperekedwa ndi ogwira ntchito yazaumoyo okha.
tips_ny: Mutonthoze munthuyo ndipo asasunthe, makamaka mwendo kapena dzanja lolumidwa
Chotsani mphete ndi zinthu zolimba pafupi ndi pomwe walumidwa
Pitani kuchipatala mwamsanga; musadule, kuyamwa, kumanga mwamphamvu kapena kupaka mankhwala a chikhalidwe pa bala
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Kulumidwa ndi njoka kulikonse ndi kwadzidzidzi. Pitani kuchipatala nthawi yomweyo, makamaka ngati pali kutupa, kupweteka, kutuluka magazi, kugona kwambiri kapena kupuma movutikira.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kutentha kwambiri kungayambitse thukuta lambiri, kupweteka mutu, chizungulire ndi kufooka. Ngati sikuchiritsidwa kungasanduke heatstroke, yomwe ndi ngozi yadzidzidzi.
tips_ny: Sunthirani pamalo ozizira a mthunzi ndi kugona pansi
Chotsani zovala zochuluka ndi kumwa madzi ozizira pang'onopang'ono
Zizirani khungu ndi nsalu yonyowa kapena mpepo
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Munthuyo akapanda kuchira pakatha mphindi 30, ali ndi kutentha thupi kwambiri, kusokonezeka maganizo, khunyu kapena kukomoka, pitani naye kuchipatala nthawi yomweyo.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Poizoni angachokere ku mankhwala, mankhwala apakhomo, mankhwala opha tizilombo a m'minda ndi zomera zina. Ana ali pachiopsezo chachikulu. Kuchita mwamsanga n'kofunika.
tips_ny: Chotsani munthuyo pafupi ndi chomwe chamuvulaza ndipo musamusanzitse
Sungani botolo kapena lemba kuti muwonetse ogwira ntchito yazaumoyo
Sungani mankhwala, mankhwala a m'minda ndi palafini kutali ndi ana
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Poizoni wokayikitsa nthawi zonse ndi wadzidzidzi. Pitani kuchipatala nthawi yomweyo, makamaka akagona kwambiri, kupuma movutikira kapena khunyu.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Fupa lothyoka limayambitsa kupweteka, kutupa komanso nthawi zina mawonekedwe osiyana. Limafunika kuyezedwa kuchipatala nthawi zambiri ndi X-ray.
tips_ny: Sungani malo ovulala osasuntha ndipo muwathandize ndi nsalu kapena mkanda wa dzanja
Musayese kuwongola fupalo ndipo musalipondereze
Ikani ayezi wokulungidwa munsalu ndipo muletse magazi ndi kukanikiza koyera
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukaganiza kuti fupa lathyoka, pitani kuchipatala mwamsanga, makamaka ngati pali bala, kupweteka kwambiri, kuoneka kosiyana, kusamva, kapena dzanja kapena mwendo ukakhala wozizira kapena wotuwa.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Zizindikiro zochenjeza pa nthawi ya mimba
entries.content_ny: Kupita ku chipatala nthawi zonse pa nthawi ya mimba kumasunga mayi ndi mwana athanzi. Zizindikiro zina pa nthawi ya mimba zimaonetsa vuto lalikulu ndipo zimafunika chithandizo chachangu.
tips_ny: Pitani ku chipatala pa nthawi yonse yoyembekezera ndipo konzekerani kubadwira kuchipatala ndi wothandizira waluso
Imwani mapiritsi a chitsulo ndi folic acid monga mwauzidwa ndipo gonani mu ukonde wa udzudzu
Idyani zakudya zosiyanasiyana ndipo pewani mowa ndi fodya
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Pitani nthawi yomweyo mukatuluka magazi, mutu waukulu, kuona kosaoneka bwino, kutupa nkhope kapena manja, khunyu, kutentha thupi kwambiri, kupweteka kwambiri m'mimba, kupuma movutikira, kutuluka madzi, kapena mwana kusasuntha kapena kusuntha pang'ono.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Mkaka wa m'mawere ndiye chakudya chabwino kwambiri cha makanda. WHO imalangiza kuyamba kuyamwitsa pakatha ola limodzi mwana atabadwa, kuyamwitsa mkaka wokha kwa miyezi 6 yoyamba, kenako kupitiriza ndi zakudya zina zotetezeka mpaka zaka ziwiri kapena kuposerapo.
tips_ny: Yambani kuyamwitsa pakatha ola limodzi mwana atabadwa
Yamwitsani mwana akafuna usana ndi usiku ndipo onetsetsani kuti akugwira bwino bere
Kuyambira miyezi 6 onjezerani zakudya zotetezeka komanso zopatsa thanzi pamene mukupitiriza kuyamwitsa
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mwana akapanda kuyamwa bwino, kuchepa kukodza, kunenepa pang'ono, kapena mayi akamva kupweteka kwa bere ndi chotupa chofiira kapena kutentha thupi, pitani kuchipatala. Amayi omwe ali ndi HIV atsatire uphungu wa wogwira ntchito yazaumoyo.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Katemera wa ana wanthawi zonse amateteza ku matenda oopsa monga chikuku, ziwalo (polio), TB, chibayo, chifuwa cha kokoka (whooping cough), tetanasi ndi hepatitis B.
tips_ny: Tsatirani ndondomeko ya katemera ya dziko ndipo sungani khadi la mwana bwino
Patsani katemera pa nthawi yake; matenda ofatsa nthawi zambiri si chifukwa chochedwetsera
Kutentha thupi pang'ono kapena kupweteka pa malo opangira jakisoni ndi zofala ndipo zimatha msanga
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mwana walephera katemera (funsani za kuthamangitsa), kapena atalandira katemera ali ndi kutentha thupi kwambiri, khunyu, kupuma movutikira kapena kutupa nkhope, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Ana amataya madzi mwamsanga akamatsegula m'mimba ndi kusanza. ORS ndi kupitiriza kudyetsa zimapewa kuchepa madzi m'thupi, ndipo zinc yoperekedwa monga wogwira ntchito yazaumoyo walangiza imafupikitsa kutsegula m'mimba.
tips_ny: Patsani ORS pang'ono pang'ono ndipo yamwitsani kawirikawiri
Pitirizani kudyetsa mwana monga mwa nthawi zonse
Patsani zinc pokhapokha wogwira ntchito yazaumoyo walangiza
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mwana ali ndi maso olowa mkati, wopanda misozi, pakamwa pouma, wakodza pang'ono kapena wosakodza, wagona kwambiri kapena walefuka, sangathe kumwa, kapena ali ndi magazi mu chimbudzi, pitani kuchipatala nthawi yomweyo.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Masiku 28 oyamba ndi nthawi yosatetezeka kwambiri pa moyo wa mwana. Kutentha, chisamaliro choyera ndi kuyamwitsa msanga zimasunga makanda athanzi.
tips_ny: Sungani mwana wofunda mwa kumukumbatira khungu ndi khungu
Sungani chingwe cha mchombo choyera ndi chouma
Yamwitsani msanga komanso kawirikawiri, ndipo sambani m'manja musanakhudze mwana
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mwana akapanda kuyamwa, ali ndi kutentha thupi kapena akuzizira kwambiri, akupuma mofulumira, ali ndi khungu kapena maso achikasu, mchombo wofiira kapena wotuluka mafinya, khunyu, kapena ndi walefuka, pitani kuchipatala nthawi yomweyo.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Zakudya zabwino zimaphatikizapo zipatso, ndiwo zamasamba, nyemba, mtedza ndi mbewu zosakonzedwa, ndipo zimachepetsa mchere, shuga ndi mafuta oipa.
tips_ny: Idyani zakudya zosiyanasiyana, kuphatikizapo zipatso ndi ndiwo zamasamba zosachepera 5 patsiku
Muchepetse mchere ndi shuga ndipo imwani madzi m'malo mwa zakumwa zotsekemera
Sankhani njira zophikira zomwe zimagwiritsa ntchito mafuta ochepa ndipo pewani zakudya zokazinga zambiri
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mukuonda popanda chifukwa, mwasiya kufuna kudya kwa nthawi yaitali, kapena mukuvutika kupeza chakudya chokwanira, lankhulani ndi wogwira ntchito yazaumoyo kapena ntchito yazakudya.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.topic_ny: Kuperewera kwa zakudya m'thupi kwa ana
entries.condition_ny: Kusowa chakudya kapena zakudya zokwanira zakukula
entries.content_ny: Kuperewera kwa zakudya kungaoneke ngati kuonda kwambiri, kukhala wamfupi kuposa msinkhu, kapena kutupa mapazi. Kudyetsa bwino, kuyeza kukula ndi kuchiza matenda msanga kumateteza ana.
tips_ny: Yamwitsani mkaka wa m'mawere wokha kwa miyezi 6, kenako onjezerani zakudya zosiyanasiyana monga nyemba, mtedza, mazira, nsomba, zipatso ndi ndiwo zamasamba
Pitani ku chipatala kukayeza kukula kwa mwana
Chiritsani matenda monga kutsegula m'mimba ndi malungo mwamsanga
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Mwana akaonda kwambiri, mapazi atatupa, sakufuna kudya, kapena walefuka ndi wogona kwambiri, mutengereni kuchipatala, komwe angamupatse chakudya chapadera cha chithandizo.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Kusamba m'manja ndi sopo ndi madzi oyera ndi imodzi mwa njira zogwira ntchito kwambiri zopewera kutsegula m'mimba, matenda opuma ndi matenda ena ambiri.
tips_ny: Nyowetsani manja, pakani sopo ndipo kolani mbali zonse kwa masekondi osachepera 20
Sambani musanadye kapena kuphika, ndi mukatuluka kuchimbudzi kapena kusintha thewera
Sambani mutasamalira munthu wodwala
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Kusamba m'manja sikuchiza matenda. Pitani kwa wogwira ntchito yazaumoyo ngati inu kapena mwana mukutsegula m'mimba kosalekeza, kutentha thupi kapena matenda a pakhungu.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.content_ny: Madzi odetsedwa amafalitsa matenda monga kolera, typhoid ndi kutsegula m'mimba. Kuwiritsa kapena kuyeretsa madzi kumawapangitsa kukhala abwino akumwa.
tips_ny: Wiritsani madzi mpaka ayambe kuphulika kwa mphindi imodzi, kapena muwayeretse ndi chlorine monga mwalangizidwa
Sungani madzi oyeretsedwa mu chidebe choyera ndi chotsekedwa
Gwiritsani chikho choyera kapena supuni yaikulu yoyera potunga madzi
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Inu kapena mwana mukayamba kutsegula m'mimba, kusanza kapena zizindikiro za kuchepa madzi m'thupi mutamwa madzi osayeretsedwa, pitani kuchipatala.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.

entries.condition_ny: Kukhala ndi nkhawa, mantha kapena kulemedwa
entries.content_ny: Nkhawa ndi kupsinjika maganizo ndi zofala. Zizolowezi zosavuta zimathandiza, ndipo thandizo lilipo pamene nkhawa yayamba kusokoneza moyo wa tsiku ndi tsiku.
tips_ny: Lankhulani ndi munthu amene mumamukhulupirira za momwe mukumvera
Chitani masewera olimbitsa thupi ndipo mugone mokwanira
Yesani kupuma pang'onopang'ono mozama ndipo muchepetse mowa
entries.see_doctor_if_ny: Nkhawa ikakhala yosalekeza ndi yosokoneza moyo wanu, mukakhala ndi mantha owopsa kapena kusagona kwa masabata, kapena kumwa mowa kapena mankhwala osokoneza bongo kuti muthane nazo, pitani kwa wogwira ntchito yazaumoyo. Ngati muli ndi maganizo odzivulaza, funani thandizo nthawi yomweyo kwa wogwira ntchito yazaumoyo, thandizo ladzidzidzi kapena munthu wapafupi.
entries.translation_status: AI draft. Needs review by a fluent Chichewa speaker and a health worker before use.
